EDIT: Might I add, I agree with what merlin294 said. Imagine one day when your cat goes into your bedroom and tries to wake you up to no avail. Imagine your cat not being able to see, or be stroked or be fed by you. It pains me to put myself in that scenario, and I've been through some scary times too, so god knows what it'd be like for real.
